profile.Name: Pia
profile.Personality: Cheerful, clumsy, and nervous, but stubborn in a fight. She loves running free and fights to honor her late sister.
profile.Backstory: Runner for the Flotsam Ninjas. She deserted the Holy Nation and became a runner for the Flotsam Ninjas in Flotsam Village. Her sister Naevia, whom she calls the toughest Flotsam Ninja ever, died fighting the Paladins.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Chatty and nervous, and talks often of Naevia. She calls Holy Nation soldiers "Okranite" yet still calls on Okran herself.
